failedSafeguard.cause: IncludeRecordedCustodyAsync triggers closure only for locally requested unmatched arrivals, but broad enrichment applies to every original peer identity with replayable arrivals, including positions that did not request closure. All 18 failed positions have localRequested=false and qualifying peers elsewhere. Broad/warehouse reads enrich them; narrow reads do not.

decision: NO-GO: 18 positions have room/command-source recorded-custody dependency and fingerprint disagreements; no advancement or application patch.
